title: Jira Work Item Operational Metadata
description: Portable planning metadata projected onto a Jira work item. Runtime outcomes and telemetry-derived fields are intentionally excluded until a telemetry adapter can populate them from authoritative evidence.

workItemKey.description: Stable Jira issue key, for example PROJ-9.

accountableHumanId.description: Portable identifier for the natural person accountable for the work item. Runtime adapters project this value onto their native human-assignment field.
